title: CI scan_ruby is red on 4 pre-existing brakeman warnings -- 3x SendFile on DB-stored paths, 1x Rails 8.0.4 EOL
evidence: Measured 2026-10-12 with the bumped brakeman 8.1.0 (bin/brakeman --no-pager, rc=3 = warnings found; brakeman exits non-zero on warnings by default, so scan_ruby fails): SendFile/Medium on app/controllers/images_controller.rb:6 (ImageCandidate#image_path), app/controllers/media_controller.rb:43 (Photo#servable_file_path -- the STILL path, predates the reel work) and app/controllers/media_controller.rb:75 (Post#reel_path, added 2026-09-24); plus EOLRails/Medium -- Rails 8.0.4 support ends 2026-11-07. All 4 are pre-existing and were invisible for ~6.5 weeks because scan_ruby died at exit 5 on --ensure-latest before it ever scanned. NO config/brakeman.ignore has ever existed here (git log --all: empty), so silencing them introduces a new practice; the send_file pattern is one this codebase deliberately ships (the still path has carried it for months). Recommendation: harden the three send_file sites to assert the resolved path is inside an allowed root, and schedule the Rails upgrade, rather than adding ignore entries.

notes.note: routed agent: the code fixes are in-repo; the only part needing Tim is any decision to ignore a security warning, which the recommendation avoids
